note: The tcg#4 host inventory as DATA, not prose: every target states which axis
it exists to vary, how to obtain it, and whether it needs a paid pod. The
rationale is a field rather than a comment so a report can cite why a host
was in the matrix. Copy this file, fill in real endpoints, and run:
then drop --dry-run once the printed command sequence looks right.
setup[] runs on the TARGET before the probe. Keep the torch build identical
to the build host wherever the intent is to isolate an OS-level axis: if
torch moves too, several axes differ at once and the contingency can only
fail closed across all of them.

targets.name: local-build-host
targets.axis_intent: the build host itself — the all-axes-equal control row

targets.name: debian12-glibc236
targets.axis_intent: glibc/libstdcxx/os_release one LTS step below the build host

targets.name: debian11-glibc231
targets.axis_intent: glibc/libstdcxx two LTS steps below — the oldest base worth supporting

targets.name: worker-cuda-current
targets.axis_intent: the production worker image in service — the reference environment
targets.obtain: runpod/vast CPU pod booted from the current worker release image

targets.name: worker-cuda-previous
targets.axis_intent: previous worker release image — does a release bump invalidate the cache?
targets.obtain: same provider, previous worker release image tag

targets.name: torch-same-minor-different-patch
targets.obtain: any CPU pod; pip install the neighbouring torch patch of the build host's minor

targets.name: triton-absent
targets.axis_intent: triton — present on the build host, absent here
targets.obtain: CPU pod with the build host's torch but no triton installed

targets.name: avx512-host
targets.axis_intent: host_isa_level/host_isa_features above the build host's x86-64-v3 clamp
targets.obtain: provider instance type with avx512 (check /proc/cpuinfo before booting the matrix)

targets.name: v3-only-host
targets.axis_intent: host_isa_* at exactly the compilation clamp — the floor case
targets.obtain: older provider instance type without avx512
